title: The Escarpment of Cape Reckoning
author: Juniper Underhill
blurb: Ines Vane, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent five years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
